candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe with wahala for 3 days. Mama talk say e never get convulsion before and e no dey convulse now. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. I count im breath for one minute and I count 35 breaths. I check am when e calm. E chest dey go inside when e dey breathe. E no get stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze and e no get recurrent wheeze. We no get pulse oximeter for here. Di pikin dey exposed to or e get HIV.
